title: Lead Pass Lines
description: A passer leads a running teammate with a pass into the space ahead of them, so the receiver catches in stride without slowing down.

content.objective: Pass to where a moving teammate will be, not where they are, so the catch happens in stride.
content.setup: Passers at the top of the key with balls; runners line up at the wing.
content.organization: Runner becomes passer; passer goes to the runner line.
instructions: The runner jogs from the wing toward the basket along the lane line.
The passer throws a bounce or chest pass one stride ahead of the runner.
The runner catches in stride and finishes with a lay-up.
Increase the runner's speed each round.
coachingPoints: Aim at the space ahead of the runner's lead hand.
Pass early, as soon as the runner's direction is clear.
Runners show a target with the outside hand.
commonMistakes: Waiting until the runner arrives and throwing too late.
content.safety: Runners finish and clear to the baseline away from the next runner's path.
progressions: Runner changes direction once (V-cut) before the pass.
Pass from the opposite slot for a longer lead.
variations: Overhead lead pass from half court.
Lead pass to a back-door cut.
successCriteria: Runner catches without breaking stride on 8 of 10 passes.
content.gameApplication: Leading cutters with the pass turns a half-step advantage into a lay-up.
